narration: No interest? Then why the interest bill?
intended_viewer_understanding: The apparent no-interest promise can still produce a bill.
main_character_action_or_reaction: Remy looks from a teal offer to a coral receipt, eyebrows raised.
diagram_chart: No chart; the promise and bill are juxtaposed.
visual_metaphor: An offer with a second financial consequence.
expected_keyframe_motion: Start on meaningful hero; reveal receipt on “bill”; no logo intro.
reusable_vs_custom_artwork: Reuse thumbnail A head, offer and receipt grammar.
accuracy_or_layout_note: Keep headline and receipt near center; no dollar amount.

narration: Imagine buying a sofa on a store card: “No interest if paid in full within twelve months.”
intended_viewer_understanding: The purchase and twelve-month condition are hypothetical.
main_character_action_or_reaction: Remy brings a sofa into the living-room layout and reads the card.
diagram_chart: Calendar strip labeled illustrative 12-month offer; not actual account dates.
visual_metaphor: A household purchase starts a contractual clock.
expected_keyframe_motion: Sofa slides to a settled position; reveal condition as it is spoken.
reusable_vs_custom_artwork: New sofa and room modules; reusable Remy and offer.
accuracy_or_layout_note: Do not portray a named retailer or real customer.

intended_viewer_understanding: The full-payment condition controls the outcome.
main_character_action_or_reaction: Remy points directly at IF, gaze following fingertip.
visual_metaphor: IF behaves like a switch between possible outcomes.
expected_keyframe_motion: Local push to IF; brief hold; do not animate unrelated props.
reusable_vs_custom_artwork: Reuse thumbnail A hero; later custom pointing pose.
accuracy_or_layout_note: Make full condition legible in video even when thumbnail text is small.

narration: With deferred interest, interest builds from purchase day. It just hasn't been charged yet.
intended_viewer_understanding: Accruing interest and being charged interest are different events.
main_character_action_or_reaction: Remy pulls the offer aside to reveal a separate interest ledger.
diagram_chart: Two separate labeled areas: promotional balance; interest accruing.
visual_metaphor: An accumulating receipt waits beside the purchase balance.
expected_keyframe_motion: Sequential entry reveals; keep CHARGED absent until triggered.
reusable_vs_custom_artwork: Custom two-ledger layout; reuse receipt and offer.
accuracy_or_layout_note: Entries are schematic, not scaled money or secret undisclosed debt.

narration: Meet the terms and clear the promotional balance before the deadline, and that interest is waived.
intended_viewer_understanding: Full compliant payoff avoids the accrued interest charge.
main_character_action_or_reaction: Remy transfers the last payment token, then relaxes.
objects_props: Payment token; promotional balance card; receipt
diagram_chart: Paid-in-full branch; accrued-interest entries cleared with WAIVED.
visual_metaphor: The conditional switch cancels the waiting receipt.
expected_keyframe_motion: Directed token transfer, balance clears, receipt masks out; hold payoff.
reusable_vs_custom_artwork: Reuse ledger; new token and relieved expression.
onscreen_text_qualifier: PAID IN FULL + TERMS MET / INTEREST WAIVED
accuracy_or_layout_note: Terms include required timely payments. Label prevents unconditional payoff claim.

narration: Leave some unpaid, and the accumulated interest can land on your bill.
intended_viewer_understanding: Leaving a promotional balance at expiration can trigger accumulated interest.
main_character_action_or_reaction: Return to alternative scenario; Remy stops as the calendar turns.
diagram_chart: Branch label IF BALANCE REMAINS; accrued receipt joins bill.
visual_metaphor: A waiting charge is released at expiry.
expected_keyframe_motion: Show ALTERNATIVE first; turn page, then transfer receipt; no explosion.
reusable_vs_custom_artwork: Reuse props; custom concerned pose and branch state.
accuracy_or_layout_note: Avoid suggesting the same shopper simultaneously takes both paths.

narration: Not just interest on what's left: interest calculated across the balances you carried since buying the sofa.
intended_viewer_understanding: The interest relates to balances carried through the promotional period.
main_character_action_or_reaction: Remy follows a line back to the sofa purchase.
objects_props: Receipt; calendar strip; sofa mini silhouette
diagram_chart: Balance cards decrease with payments; interest entries accumulate separately.
visual_metaphor: A line traces the purchase history backward.
expected_keyframe_motion: Trace backward from bill to purchase; reveal prior balance cards sequentially.
reusable_vs_custom_artwork: Custom time/ledger composition using existing props.
accuracy_or_layout_note: Never draw constant original principal after payments; no invented chart units.

narration: Even making every minimum payment might not clear it in time.
intended_viewer_understanding: On-time minimum payments do not necessarily finish the promotional payoff.
main_character_action_or_reaction: Remy places payment checkmarks but notices a remaining balance.
objects_props: Payment tokens; calendar; promotional balance card
diagram_chart: Payment checkmarks and an explicitly nonempty balance card.
visual_metaphor: A checklist can be complete while the payoff is incomplete.
expected_keyframe_motion: Checkmark reveals followed by remaining-balance highlight.
reusable_vs_custom_artwork: Reuse modules; new checkmark symbol only.
accuracy_or_layout_note: Use “may” in supporting copy; do not claim all minimum schedules fail.

narration: A true zero-percent introductory APR is different. Leaving a balance doesn't trigger interest for that zero-percent period.
intended_viewer_understanding: True zero-percent introductory APR has different retrospective treatment.
main_character_action_or_reaction: Remy separates the two offer types with open hands.
diagram_chart: Deferred: accrues during offer; true 0%: no promo-period interest, later interest possible.
visual_metaphor: Two doors with different rules, not identical promises.
expected_keyframe_motion: Build panels one at a time; cross out retrospective receipt only on true-zero side.
reusable_vs_custom_artwork: Custom comparison layout; reuse offer/receipt and new open-hand pose.
onscreen_text_qualifier: TRUE 0% INTRO APR / Interest may start after promotion
accuracy_or_layout_note: Do not label a deferred-interest offer 0% APR. Keep this contrast readable.

narration: So check the promotion's deadline, not just your monthly payment date.
intended_viewer_understanding: The promotional expiry and ordinary monthly due date are distinct checks.
main_character_action_or_reaction: Remy circles the promotional deadline and checks the promotional balance.
diagram_chart: Distinct labels for promotion expiry and payment due; no fabricated dates.
visual_metaphor: Two clocks can govern one bill.
expected_keyframe_motion: Reveal due-date card, then highlight separate expiry card.
accuracy_or_layout_note: No personalized due date or repayment instruction.

narration: The sofa came home on day one.
intended_viewer_understanding: Return to the original deferred-interest purchase.
main_character_action_or_reaction: Remy sits beside the newly arrived sofa and looks toward purchase day.
visual_metaphor: The sofa arrives before any interest is charged.
expected_keyframe_motion: Return to established room; clock settles; short breath.
reusable_vs_custom_artwork: Reuse room and sofa; later seated/leaning pose if needed.
accuracy_or_layout_note: Re-establish deferred-interest scope after the zero-percent comparison.

narration: The interest was waiting there too.
intended_viewer_understanding: Deferred interest was accruing from purchase day, conditional on later payoff.
main_character_action_or_reaction: Remy notices the waiting receipt, then looks back at IF.
visual_metaphor: The waiting receipt completes the opening question.
expected_keyframe_motion: Receipt reveal, subtle backward clock movement, then hold ending.
reusable_vs_custom_artwork: Reuse thumbnail B groups and A condition token.
onscreen_text_qualifier: Waived when payoff conditions are met
accuracy_or_layout_note: No CTA; no inevitable charge or fake financial amount.
